decisions.rationale: dataset.duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 over dataset.row_count 3322, so no exact duplicate rows exist in bronze and no dedupe step is proposed.
tailnum has distinct_count 3322 and null_count 0 against row_count 3322, one row per aircraft registration, so it is the smallest defensible grain and is proposed required.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta all carry is_airbyte_metadata true and are dropped per the metadata rule.
speed has null_rate 0.993076 (3299 nulls) but its 13 distinct values between 90.0 and 432.0 are real measurements; the column is retained nullable with no imputation and no row loss.
year has null_rate 0.021072 (70 nulls) with min 1956.0 and max 2013.0; unknown build years are kept as null rather than failing the build.
year, engines, seats, and speed all land as DECIMAL(38,9) but every profiled sample or distinct value is integral, so each is cast to INTEGER for storage and comparison clarity.
model samples disagree in shape ('150' numeric-looking versus '172E' and '210-5(205)'), so the column stays VARCHAR instead of being typed numerically.

purpose: silver_nyc_planes is the cleaned aircraft reference table derived from bronze.nyc_planes: one row per aircraft tail number (3322 rows) carrying airframe attributes (manufacture year, airframe type, manufacturer, model, engine count, seat count, cruise speed, engine type). It feeds flight-level joins that need aircraft characteristics such as capacity or engine class.
usage: Join on tailnum, which is the declared grain and unique across all 3322 profiled rows. year, engines, seats, and speed are integers after cast, so numeric aggregation works directly. Treat speed as optional enrichment only: it is populated for roughly 0.7% of rows, so any average or filter on it must handle nulls deliberately. manufacturer values are as-landed and include near-duplicate vendor spellings such as 'AIRBUS' and 'AIRBUS INDUSTRIE'; group with care or map them downstream.
limitations: No deduplication was applied because duplicate_row_rate is 0.0. No value normalization was performed: manufacturer (35 distinct) retains variant vendor spellings and model (127 distinct) retains mixed alphanumeric codes, so neither is a controlled vocabulary. speed is effectively unusable for population-level statistics at null_rate 0.993076, and year is missing for 70 rows (null_rate 0.021072). The profile carried no distinct_values list for tailnum, manufacturer, model, year, or seats (each exceeds the max_distinct_values cap of 20), so uniqueness and value-domain claims beyond the cited distinct_count figures remain to be verified against the warehouse.
